title: Add transactional downgrade-guard, version-pinning and backup/restore hooks for private-installer
author: Jordan Lee
commits: initial: add transactional downgrade guard framework and hooks
db: add transactional migration flag and migration scripts
installer: add backup/restore orchestration and helm pre/post hooks
terraform: pin module versions and add upgrade lock variables
tests: add e2e smoke tests for upgrade/rollback flows
description: Context: Private deployments require stronger upgrade/rollback guarantees for on-prem/VPC customers. This PR implements a coordinated, transactional upgrade flow that provides: 1) explicit version-pinning for critical components, 2) pre-upgrade backup and post-upgrade verification hooks, 3) transactional-friendly schema migrations with downgrade guards and idempotent rollback scripts. Motivation: recent internal upgrades highlighted a class of failures where partial schema changes combined with incompatible image roll-forwards caused long outages for customers. This work reduces blast radius and adds explicit safety gates targeted at Private installer flows. What changed (high-level): - Add a downgrade-guard controller helm template that prevents new deployments from rolling forward if a post-migration verification fails. - Add backup/restore orchestration scripts (installer/scripts/backup-restore.py) wired into Helm pre-install/pre-upgrade and post-upgrade hooks. - Add transactional migration flag and two migration SQL scripts that make schema changes reversible and idempotent (migrations/...sql). - Add terraform variables to pin module/provider versions and a TTL-lock variable used by the installer to gate parallel upgrades. - Add end-to-end smoke tests that run an upgrade, run verification checks, then exercise a rollback path. - Document the upgrade procedure and operator recovery steps in installer/docs/upgrade.md. Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-7682) - [x] Integration tests added (e2e smoke) - [x] Helm hooks added and tested in a local KIND cluster - [x] Terraform pinning tested against staging modules - [x] Rollback path validated with simulated failures - [x] Docs updated - [x] Security review for backup data flow (SUP-4128) CI notes: First CI run failed on the DB migration unit test (missing transactional wrapper in one migration). Follow-up commit added the wrapper and made rollbacks idempotent. Final CI status: all checks passed (lint, unit, integration, e2e-smoke on staging). Review summary: - Miguel: requested a stronger guard on the backup retention (ensured backups are retained >= 24h and added explicit retention config) - Priya: asked for clearer failure-mode docs; added a recovery sub-section and runbook in installer/docs/upgrade.md - Samira: requested a canary procedure; added an opt-in canary TTL variable and documented usage. Merge: Approved by reviewers and merged on 2024-10-22 via squash merge after successful CI. Follow-ups tracked in ENG-7710 (add automated rollback metrics) and ENG-7805 (operator UX improvements).
review_comments: Miguel Torres: Please ensure backups are kept for at least 24h and that retention is configurable. - Addressed in commit 3, added retention config to values.yaml
Priya Shah: Can you document the exact failure modes and operator steps for a failed verify? Suggest a small runbook. - Added runbook section to installer/docs/upgrade.md
Samira Patel: For large clusters we should support canary upgrades. Can we add a TTL lock or canary flag? - Added canary_ttl variable and documented canary rollout steps
release_notes: Private installer: Add transactional downgrade guard, backup/restore hooks, version pinning for upgrade safety, and idempotent rollback-ready schema migrations. Operators should follow installer/docs/upgrade.md for the new upgrade and rollback flow. Backwards compatible for existing installs; enable transactional mode via values.yaml.
notes_for_release_team: This PR introduces a new helm value 'transactionalMigration.enabled' (default: false) and 'backupRetention.hours' (default: 24). Coordinate with private deployment customers before enabling in production clusters. Run e2e upgrade_smoke_test against staging before rolling out.
